name: experimental_BF16_RoPE_SharedL2_partial64_head256_v1
production_default: qwen2_shared_l2_rope_payload.EXPERIMENTAL_BF16_ROPE=0 retains the original body; no precision-policy acceptance implied
geometry: heads=1 or2, head_dim=256, rotary_dim=64; exact8 or16 source beats. Reject every other geometry before memory traffic
source: Head-contiguous BF16. 32 BF16 words per512-bit beat, word0 in bits15:0. Source64-byte aligned
coefficients: Explicit candidate_trig_local_i points to two64-byte-aligned BF16 beats: cos[0:31] then sin[0:31], shared across the accepted heads. No position generation/cache semantics
rotation: Per head pairs(channel i,channel i+32), i=0..31. BF16 inputs exactly promote by appending16 zeros. Existing all-products-and-terminal-BF16 candidate arithmetic remains unchanged
bypass: Channels64..255 copied bit-for-bit without conversion, NaN canonicalization, arithmetic, or exception flags
output: Actual16-bit candidate outputs directly packed once. Destination may have any even byte offset. First/last partial64-byte beats use exact2-byte-paired enables; all other bytes preserved by SharedL2 fabric
address_admission: Reject unaligned source/trig, odd destination, high-bit truncation and range overflow. Configured L2_BEATS is actualfabriccapacity, default min(2^ADDR_W,24576). AW15 default24576beats=1.5MiB; unused address encodings are rejected
ownership: start accepted only in IDLE; all config/addresses captured. Ignore busy start pulses. Read complete tensor and both coefficient beats before any store, permitting overlapping source/trig/destination ranges. One outstanding L2 read; one transaction owner
counts: Per accepted transaction, reads=8*heads+2 accepted requests; pairs=32*heads completed pair outputs; writes=8*heads+(destination byte offset!=0) accepted writes. Rejection counts all0
completion: One done cycle only after last accepted SharedL2 store. No completion backpressure interface exists in the inherited payload API; caller must observe pulse. This is not DDR acknowledgement or generic SFU tagged completion
backpressure: Read requests and registered output address/data/mask stay stable while blocked; arithmetic input and output handshake internal to endpoint
reset: Consumer and no-ID fabric/pending response path reset together, low at least2 rising clocks. Flush all pending work and output validity. Already accepted stores remain; no atomic rollback or stale-response-after-uncoordinated-reset guarantee
fixture_scope: All163840 unique immutable local/remote real rotarypairs and327680native outputs, plus explicitly supplemental grouped replays. Unrotated192-lane tails are synthetic adversarial raw BF16 payloads
